index.title: Index
index.description: An index for the google mail endpoint.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Client ID of the gmail application.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Client Secret of the gmail application.

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: OAuth 2 access token for google mail application. This typically expires after an hour so refreshToken is recommended for long term usage.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth 2 refresh token for google mail application. Using this, the Google Calendar component can obtain a new accessToken whenever the current one expires - a necessity if the application is long-lived.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: The number of milliseconds before the next poll

markAsRead.title: Mark as Read
markAsRead.description: Mark the message as read once it has been consumed

labels.title: Gmail Labels
labels.description: Comma separated list of labels to take into account

query.title: Gmail Query
query.description: The query to execute on gmail box
